I independently read the complete actual Arabic page and both complete actual target blocks from disk, including the long final lines retrieved in untruncated chunks. I compared English directly with Arabic and Indonesian directly with Arabic; neither target was used as evidence for the other. I did not draft, repair, or edit either translation, the canonical source, repository files, tracker, reader, Git state, or remotes. No neighboring pages were read. Approval applies only to the three exact raw-byte SHA-256 values below.

Dhū al-Nūn identification, mercy formula, sighting, and devotional frequency
coverage.source: قال ذو النون المصري رحمه الله تعالى: رأيت شاباً عند الكعبة يكثر الركوع والسجود
coverage.english: Dhū al-Nūn the Egyptian is the reporting speaker; 'may God Most High have mercy on him' is complete. A young man at the Kaaba both bows and prostrates frequently; neither action nor frequency is omitted.
coverage.indonesian: Dhū al-Nūn dari Mesir is the reporting speaker; 'semoga Allah Yang Mahatinggi merahmatinya' is complete. A pemuda near Ka'bah 'banyak melakukan rukuk dan sujud', retaining youth, location, both actions, and frequency.

coverage.scope: First approach, observation addressed to the young man, and permission-to-depart reply
coverage.source: فدنوت منه وقلت: إنك تكثر الصلاة، فقال: انتظر الإذن من ربي في الانصراف
coverage.english: The narrator approaches and says the young man prays a great deal. The young man's reply retains waiting, permission, 'my Lord', and departure. The local note explicitly allows the uncertain first-person/imperative reading of انتظر instead of concealing it.
coverage.indonesian: The narrator approaches and addresses 'Engkau banyak mengerjakan salat'. 'Pemuda itu berkata' makes the reply's actor clear. Waiting for permission from 'Tuhanku' to leave is preserved, with the alternative 'tunggulah' locally disclosed.

coverage.scope: Second approach, fallen paper, and writing
coverage.source: فدنوت منه فرأيت رقعة سقطت عليه مكتوب فيها
coverage.english: The repeated approach remains a second 'I drew near him'; the narrator sees a slip of paper fallen upon the young man and reads writing on that paper. The paper is not recast as sent by the young man or merely found elsewhere.
coverage.indonesian: The repeated 'Aku mendekatinya' is retained, followed by seeing a sheet that had fallen upon him and 'Pada kertas itu tertulis'. No approach, paper, fall, or written-message clause is dropped.

coverage.scope: Divine letter: sender, recipient, imperative, and scope of forgiveness
coverage.source: من العزيز الغفور إلى عبدي الصادق الشكور، انصرف مغفور لك ما تقدم من ذنبك وما تأخر
coverage.english: 'From the Mighty, the Forgiving' gives both sender Names; 'to My truthful, ever-grateful servant' retains recipient, divine first-person possession, truthfulness, and gratitude. 'Depart' remains an imperative. Both earlier and later sins are included in the reported forgiveness.
coverage.indonesian: 'Dari Yang Mahaperkasa, Yang Maha Pengampun' and 'kepada hamba-Ku yang jujur lagi banyak bersyukur' preserve both Names and all recipient qualifiers. 'Pergilah' and forgiveness of both 'yang terdahulu' and 'yang kemudian' retain command and scope.

coverage.scope: Anas report, Prophet passing the praying man, and first full blessing
coverage.source: وروي عن أنس بن مالك أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مر برجل يصلي
coverage.english: 'It is related from Anas ibn Mālik' preserves report attribution without authenticating it. The Prophet passes a man who is praying; the first 'peace and blessings be upon him' includes both elements.
coverage.indonesian: 'Diriwayatkan dari Anas ibn Mālik' preserves report attribution. Nabi passes a man 'yang sedang salat'; the first 'semoga selawat dan salam tercurah kepadanya' includes both selawat and salam.

coverage.scope: Tashahhud completion and start of the man's supplication
coverage.source: فلما فرغ من التشهد جعل يقول
coverage.english: 'When the man had finished the tashahhud, he began to say' correctly assigns both completion and speech to the praying man, not the passing Prophet, and preserves their order.
coverage.indonesian: 'Setelah laki-laki itu selesai membaca tasyahud, ia mulai mengucapkan' explicitly identifies the man and retains completion before invocation.

coverage.scope: First invocation: first-person asking, praise, and exclusive divinity
coverage.source: اللهم إني أسألك بأن لك الحمد، لا إله إلا أنت
coverage.english: 'O God, I ask You by the fact that praise belongs to You; there is no god but You' preserves the speaker's first person, divine addressee, praise relationship, negation, and exception.
coverage.indonesian: 'Ya Allah, sesungguhnya aku memohon kepada-Mu dengan kenyataan bahwa bagi-Mulah segala pujian; tidak ada tuhan selain Engkau' retains first person, address, praise, and the entire negative-exceptive clause.

coverage.scope: First invocation: all five named addresses and heavens-and-earth scope
coverage.source: يا حنان يا منان، يا بديع السموات والأرض، يا حي يا قيوم
coverage.english: Ḥannān, Mannān, Badīʿ of the plural heavens and earth, Ḥayy, and Qayyūm all appear in that order with translated meanings and source-specific transliterations. No address or earth clause is omitted.
coverage.indonesian: Ḥannān, Mannān, Badīʿ langit-langit dan bumi, Ḥayy, and Qayyūm all appear in source order with meanings and transliterations. Qayyūm includes standing by oneself and sustaining all things; all five vocatives are retained.

coverage.scope: Prophet's question, second full blessing, plural response, and response content
coverage.source: فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: أتدرون ما دعا به؟ قلنا: الله ورسوله أعلم
coverage.english: The Prophet is explicitly named and receives the second full peace-and-blessings formula. The question asks by what the man supplicated. 'We said' preserves the plural reporters; 'God and His Messenger know best' retains both parties and the knowledge comparison.
coverage.indonesian: Nabi is explicitly named with the second full selawat-and-salam formula. 'Tahukah kalian dengan apa ia berdoa?' retains plural address and the means of invocation. 'Kami menjawab' is plural; 'Allah dan Rasul-Nya lebih mengetahui' retains both parties and superior knowledge.

coverage.scope: Great and greatest Name, and both conditional response clauses
coverage.source: قال: إنه دعا الله باسمه العظيم الأعظم الذي إذا دعي به أجاب، وإذا سئل به أعطى
coverage.english: The answering Prophet reports invocation of God by His 'great and greatest Name', preserving both adjectives. Both conditions remain: when He is invoked by it He answers, and when He is asked by it He gives. God, not the human supplicant, is the answering/giving actor.
coverage.indonesian: 'Nama-Nya yang agung lagi paling agung' retains both grades. The first condition explicitly names Allah as the one invoked and Dia as the one answering; the second retains asking by the Name and divine giving. These remain reported speech, not an independent efficacy assertion.

coverage.scope: Declared ten versus actual nine, exact order, and composite fourth entry
coverage.source: عشر أسماء: الواحد الأحد الصمد الفعال لما يريد السميع البصير المقتدر القوي القائم
coverage.english: 'Ten Names' is preserved and a note explicitly states that nine entries are actually printed. The list is al-Wāḥid, al-Aḥad, al-Ṣamad, al-Faʿʿāl limā yurīd, al-Samīʿ, al-Baṣīr, al-Muqtadir, al-Qawī, al-Qāʾim. The fourth is one composite entry, 'the Doer of whatever He wills'. No tenth Name is invented.
coverage.indonesian: 'Sepuluh nama' is preserved with an explicit source-count discrepancy note. The same nine independently source-checked entries remain in order. 'Yang Melakukan Apa Saja yang Dia Kehendaki' preserves the complete composite fourth phrase. No entry is split to fabricate ten or supplied from a familiar list.

coverage.scope: Meaning and distinction of all nine list entries
coverage.source: الواحد; الأحد; الصمد; الفعال لما يريد; السميع; البصير; المقتدر; القوي; القائم
coverage.english: The One; the Unique One; the One on Whom all depend; the Doer of whatever He wills; the All-Hearing; the All-Seeing; the All-Powerful; the Strong; the Subsisting One. Source-specific transliterations distinguish Wāḥid from Aḥad and final Qāʾim from the earlier Qayyūm; none is replaced by a near-familiar Name.
coverage.indonesian: Yang Satu; Yang Esa; Yang Menjadi Tempat Bergantung; Yang Melakukan Apa Saja yang Dia Kehendaki; Yang Maha Mendengar; Yang Maha Melihat; Yang Mahakuasa; Yang Mahakuat; Yang Berdiri Sendiri. The attached transliterations preserve Wāḥid/Aḥad and Qāʾim/Qayyūm as distinct source forms.

coverage.scope: Nothing better than acting by them
coverage.source: ليس شيء أفضل من العمل بها
coverage.english: 'Nothing is better than acting by them' retains the negative quantifier, comparison, action, and plural reference to the Names. It is not reduced to an unspecified favorable claim or a command with an invented repetition count.
coverage.indonesian: 'Tidak ada sesuatu yang lebih utama daripada mengamalkannya' retains the complete negative comparison and acting/practicing relationship. It does not invent a schedule or number.

coverage.scope: Further saying: unresolved speaker and benefit for burdens and difficult matters
coverage.source: فقال: إنها تنفع من معاناة الأثقال والأمور الصعاب
coverage.english: 'Then he said' has an immediate note that the speaker is not explicitly identified, rather than naming the Prophet or Dhū al-Nūn without adequate support. 'They are beneficial in coping with burdens and difficult matters' preserves the reported benefit, hardship/coping relation, and both object classes.
coverage.indonesian: 'Kemudian ia berkata' has the corresponding local Indonesian speaker-uncertainty note. The quotation retains 'Nama-nama itu', benefit 'dalam menghadapi', beban-beban, and perkara-perkara yang sulit. No theological attribution is silently resolved by a divine possessive or capitalized pronoun.

coverage.scope: Final benefit heading and claim that each Name is said to be the Greatest
coverage.source: ( فائدة ) هذا الدعاء للأسماء التي قيل إن كل اسم منها هو اسم الله الأعظم، وهو هذا
coverage.english: '(A benefit)' is present. 'This supplication is for the Names of which it has been said that each Name among them is the Greatest Name of God. It is this' retains the supplication/Names relation, hearsay attribution, distributive 'each', Greatest Name of God, and introduction to the repeated formula.
coverage.indonesian: '(Faedah)' is present. 'Doa ini adalah untuk nama-nama yang dikatakan bahwa setiap nama di antaranya merupakan Nama Allah Yang Paling Agung. Inilah doanya' retains hearsay, each individual Name, divine identity, and introduction. Neither target authenticates the assertion as the reviewer's own conclusion.
